_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows moving ±2+ points over the last week and zero confirmation breakers present (VIX still elevated, ETF flows flat, funding not negative), HOLD is the statistically honest call in this coil.
next_move.brains_agree: No—Analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing missing breakers and poor directional track record; Narrative implies an imminent squeeze setup but provides no actionable trigger timing
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX drops below 15 AND ETF flows turn positive (>20) within 48h, loosening the risk-off grip and opening a move up to Denial
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 22 OR BTC funding flips negative, confirming panic leg resumption and a drop toward Capitulation
